title: cdak — Quite & Orange, 4K for Windows
author: Quite & Orange, PRISM
notes: Chaos Constructions 2010, 4K intro: a raymarched scene in an HLSL pixel shader drawn through Direct3D 9, ping-ponged between render targets, with synthesized music through waveOut, packed by Crinkler. MIRAGE-WIN32 makes d3d9.dll and d3dx9_37.dll in JavaScript: the COM objects, their vtables, D3DXCompileShader handing the HLSL source on in its blob; PRISM's d3d9.js and hlsl.js translate the HLSL to GLSL ES and draw it with WebGL2.
